# FitWinner

> FitWinner is an iPhone and Apple Watch app that connects calorie tracking to your training. Your daily calorie target, macros and a daily form score (recovery) are calculated on your phone with fixed formulas from your own data; optional AI turns those numbers into plain-language comments. Made by EK Digital Technologies OÜ. Status: closed beta, coming soon to the App Store.

Türkçe: FitWinner, kalori takibini antrenmanınla birleştiren bir iPhone ve Apple Watch uygulamasıdır. Günlük kalori hedefin, makroların ve form skorun telefonunda, senin verilerinle hesaplanır; dilersen yapay zekâ sonuçları sade bir dille yorumlar.

## What it does
- Daily calorie target that follows training: planned and completed workouts change that day's target
- Macro targets (protein, carbohydrate, fat) that follow the calorie target
- Daily form score from sleep, fatigue, muscle soreness, stress and training load; Apple Watch / Apple Health data (resting heart rate, HRV, sleep) is included when connected
- Weekly training plan with recovery days and load reduction before a match or race
- Meal timing around training (before, during, after a session) and food suggestions from remaining calories
- Food logging with a food database that includes Turkish dishes; recipes built from ingredients
- Fluid tracking, supplement information with evidence levels, workout reminders with "Done" / "Snooze"

## Key facts
- Platforms: iPhone; Apple Watch optional (not required)
- No account needed; calculations run on the phone and work offline
- AI is optional and only runs with the user's permission; no name, email or account details are sent
- AI does not do the calculations; it only interprets them
- Pricing: free version; detailed AI comments, plan explanations and AI food estimates are part of FitWinner Premium (monthly subscription)
- Health screening and safety warnings are free in every version
- For users 18 and over. Not a medical device; it does not diagnose or recommend treatment
- App languages (11): Turkish, English, French, Dutch, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Greek, Czech, Estonian
- Availability: closed beta; App Store release will be announced on fitwinner.app
